sentences.en: Of course, I'm young, and politics is conducted by grown-ups.
sentences.zh: 当然，我是年轻人，政治是由成年人来操作的。

sentences.en: Such conduct would subject the offender to a heavy penalty.
sentences.zh: 这种行为会让违规者面临严厉的处罚。

sentences.en: Taking all things into consideration, his conduct can be excused.
sentences.zh: 综合考虑各种因素后，他的行为可以得到原谅。

mnemonic: 词根记忆：con（加强）+duct（引导）→指导
